description: Posts a note (Asana comment) on an intake matter or a task. Opened-matter projects cannot accept comments; a comment goes on one of the matter's tasks. Asana notifies followers. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

matter_id.description: Intake matter id, or any task id (an opened matter's tasks come from list_matter_tasks).

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

text.description: Note text. Posted as an Asana comment.

name: create_matter_note
title: Add matter note
